Stripe and PayPal block your access, not because of your work, but because of your location. Workarounds like using a U.S. VPN or borrowing a friend’s account fail under pressure. They aren’t infrastructure. They’re temporary hacks that collapse when you need them most. This post compares your real options for selling ebooks without PayPal or Stripe. We analyze four alternatives side-by-side: Gumroad, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-explained-digital-creators-4|Lemon Squeezy]] Squeezy, Paddle, and sovereign commerce infrastructure. Each option has tradeoffs. Only one gives you permanent ownership and control. We’ll tell you which one—and why it wins.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are platforms that rent you access to payment processing, hosting, and delivery. They handle everything—until they don’t. If your country is restricted, their dashboards are useless. Even if you bypass restrictions, your account can be suspended without warning. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, is different. It’s not a platform. It’s your own stack of tools deployed under your control. GitHub Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. You own the code, the data, and the infrastructure. No platform can suspend your account because there is no platform. This is base-layer architecture—built to last, not to rent.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle exclude Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions outright. Their terms of service explicitly block these countries. Even if you use a VPN to sign up, payment processing fails because your buyer’s IP or currency gives you away. Sovereign commerce infrastructure doesn’t care about your location. It’s deployed on global, permissionless networks. Cloudflare and GitHub don’t ask for your address. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. Your buyers pay in USDT, USDC, or SOL. The transaction settles on-chain, and your product delivers automatically. No platform gatekeeper. No geographic restrictions. This is what infrastructure sovereignty looks like.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per sale. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle take 5-10%. These fees cut into your margins. Worse, payouts take 2-7 days and often fail due to banking restrictions in your region. Crypto payments through NOWPayments (integrated into the Edge Commerce Stack) cost 0.5% per transaction. Funds settle on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost of sovereign infrastructure is the $197 deployment fee for the Edge Commerce Stack. After that, you pay nothing except the 0.5% transaction fee. No monthly subscriptions. No revenue share. This is the cheapest and fastest option—if you’re building for the long term.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own the stack—no platform can suspend your account.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle, your store, customer data, and payment history belong to them. If they shut down or suspend your account, you lose everything. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store lives on GitHub Pages. Order data sits in your Supabase database. Files deliver from Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Automation is built into the stack. When a payment confirms on-chain, a webhook fires, and your product delivers instantly. No manual intervention. No platform dependence. This is automation you own—not rent.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling one-off products and don’t care about long-term ownership, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy might work—if you can bypass their restrictions. If you’re building a serious business, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only option. The Edge Commerce Stack gives you permanent control over your store, payments, and data. It’s deployed in 48 hours, configured for your products, and tested end-to-end. Choose this if you’re tired of workarounds. Choose this if you want infrastructure, not rentals. Choose this if you’re ready to own your commerce stack.

Deployment costs $197, but there are no recurring fees. This is permanent infrastructure—not a temporary workaround.

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for Cloudflare-based infrastructure or Sovereign Starter Stack for GitHub-based deployment. 2. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The stack is deployed and configured for you. You don’t need to write code. After deployment, managing your store is as simple as updating a spreadsheet.
What cryptocurrencies can my buyers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend USDT, USDC, or SOL for stability and low fees. Buyers can also pay with BTC, ETH, or any other coin on the list.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually through your crypto wallet. Since you own the infrastructure, you control the refund process directly—no platform approval needed.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for digital products only. It automates delivery of files like ebooks, courses, and templates.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, your stack automatically retries payment verification. You can also swap in a different crypto payment processor since you own the code.
